review: Independent source-only review of bounded MPE released per-voice target repair
verdict: No source correctness blocker found. One scope wording nit should be corrected. Behavioral, native, compatibility and performance qualification are not established by this review.
inspected_scope: Exact production diff from the reviewed base to head; wrappers and private helpers for channel pressure and pitch bend; CC74 and CC121 call paths.
Current effective MPE and actual member-role classification, including channel 1 in a full upper zone and channel 16 in a full lower zone.
Raw member retention before target eligibility filtering, retained-state reset and role invalidation, accepted onset initialization, held versus pedal-held eligibility.
Accepted release lifetime, ARP generated gate close and future allocation, deferred KAS release timing, current role and enable transitions.
Preserved manager, gap, conventional and PURE routing; unchanged captured-zone policy, polyphonic-pressure path, global pressure source and optional CC74 ribbon adapter.
CC121 private reset exception, finite rejection, clamping, curve/range expressions, pedal order, smoothing targets and unchanged DSP/sample loop.

findings.result: Raw caches still update before filtering. Ordinary expression applies held-only eligibility solely to actual current effective MPE member events.

Released and pedal-held voices are excluded from ordinary member target updates. Voice::held follows accepted engine gates, including ARP synthetic gates; queued KAS release does not freeze targets before dispatch.
Only the CC121 call sites pass true to the private reset helpers. They preserve existing active-tail target resets, raw bend/pressure defaults, shared pressure reset, retained timbre and pedal order.
No source-level DSP arithmetic, sample-loop, smoothing, allocation, voice layout, scheduler or public API changes were found. This does not prove compiled-bit equivalence or performance.

The plan says physically held, while Voice::held also represents generated ARP gates. Prefer active with its accepted engine gate held (held=true); pedal hold alone does not qualify. Later KAS/ARP and shared-global caveats are accurate.

read_only_checks: git diff --check 2ade213 c0219bd completed without diagnostics.
All private helper call sites were inspected at the frozen commit.
limits: This review independently inspected source only. Baseline failure counts communicated by the parent were not rerun or independently qualified here.
Comprehensive fixtures, fault controls, compiler profiles, sanitizer coverage, native host qualification and compatibility evidence remain separate.
No claim of whole-audio isolation, complete MIDI/MPE conformance or hardware fidelity is made.
No source changes or publication were performed by this reviewer.
